37 open-source BMW projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered BMW cars and ConnectedDrive. 14 of 37 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: EdiabasLib, AAIdrive, bimmer_connected, BMW-i-Remote, Stm32-vcu (ZombieVerter).
